name: City Runners
background: The Gangs of New Eden are various factions of violent and deranged outlaws that wage eternal gang wars on the streets of New Eden. These gangs are joined by mercenaries which are not bound to any particular gang, and which fight for anyone that can provide riches or a worthy cause.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Runner
specialRules.description: If this model has Runner, it moves +2" on Advance and +4" on Rush/Charge from Runner (instead of only +1" and +2").

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Melee Shrouding Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Melee Shrouding. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Ambush Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Ambush. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Runner
specialRules.description: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Runner Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Runner. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Rapid Charge
specialRules.description: This model moves +4" when using Charge actions.

specialRules.name: Quick Shot Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Quick Shot. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Delayed Action
specialRules.description: Once per round, if your opponent has more units left to activate than you, then this model's unit may pass its turn instead of activating (may still be activated later).

specialRules.name: Hit & Run Fighter Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Hit & Run Fighter. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Anti-Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

specialRules.name: Precision Tag
specialRules.description: Once per game, during this model's activation, before attacking, place X tokens on one enemy unit within 24" and in line of sight, or one token on X enemy units within 24" and in line of sight. When attacking, friendly units may remove one token from their target before rolling to hit to get +1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Fracture
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+2).

specialRules.name: Rapid Charge Mark
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Rapid Charge against once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Enhanced Agile
specialRules.description: If this model has Agile, it moves +2" on Advance and +4" on Rush/Charge from Agile (instead of only +1" and +2").

specialRules.name: Agile
specialRules.description: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

specialRules.name: Melee Shrouding
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for charging, that enemy unit gets -2" range to a min. of 6".

specialRules.name: Quick
specialRules.description: Moves +2" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

specialRules.name: Quick Shot
specialRules.description: This model may shoot after using Rush actions.

specialRules.name: Hit & Run
specialRules.description: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee.

specialRules.name: Hit & Run Fighter
specialRules.description: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after being in melee.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: AP

specialRules.name: Blast
specialRules.description: Ignores Cover, and after resolving other special rules, each hit is multiplied by X. Hits must be split evenly between the target and all enemy units within 3” of any model from the target (defender picks how), but each unit may only take up to as many hits as models in it

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Deadly
specialRules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.
